stage.name: Llanes to Ribadesella
stage.narrative: The Playa de Gulpiyuri is 100 metres from the Atlantic but separated from it by a limestone wall. The tide enters through an underground tunnel. It is a perfect crescent of sand with waves, sitting in a meadow. You walk past it without expecting it and then you stop. Ribadesella at the end of the stage is the Sella river mouth — the Sella is the river of the Descenso del Sella, a famous international kayak race in August, and Ribadesella is where it finishes. The Tito Bustillo cave with its Paleolithic paintings (UNESCO inscribed separately) is on the far side of the bridge.
stage.closing: A beach inside a meadow. A cave with 15,000-year-old art. What does it mean to be surprised every day for three weeks?
